adjudication.rationale: The diff adds an unauthenticated endpoint `GET /embed/best` (routes.rb) that, when no existing embed is found, enqueues `:retrieve_topic` with user_id possibly nil (EmbedController#best). `ensure_embeddable` only checks `request.referer` host against `SiteSetting.embeddable_host`, not authentication, so any visitor on the allowed host can trigger it. The job ultimately calls `TopicEmbed.import_remote(user, @embed_url)` which does `open(url).read` (TopicEmbed#import_remote) without additional controls, and the throttle in `TopicRetriever#retrieved_recently?` is per-URL (`retrieved:#{@embed_url}`), so an attacker can vary paths/URLs on the same host to enqueue many distinct jobs. Additionally, `TopicRetriever#perform_retrieve` runs `Jobs::PollFeed.new.execute({})` synchronously when `feed_polling_enabled?` is true, meaning a single embed retrieval can trigger full feed polling/parsing (`SimpleRSS.parse open(...)`) inline, amplifying resource exhaustion risk.
